metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM ETERNA 500 (35 mm Type 8573), characteristic/spectral curve sheet: spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves (Status M, ECN-2) and spectral dye density, digitised from the PDF's vector paths
metadata.copyright: SpektraLab product data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is read from one.
metadata.license: Built from the manufacturer's published data sheet. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
metadata.method: spektrafilm's profile factory (9428440, GPL-3.0): D-min removed, speed point (green D 0.2) three stops under 0, C/M/Y dyes reconstructed from midscale neutral and D-min (dmid_dmin, generic starting dyes, masking couplers fitted), Status M unmixed, three normal CDFs per layer, T balance; then the shipped profiles' form reproduced from them as for the Portra NC/VC and Fujifilm AF3-207U product profiles, with upstream's grey-ramp correction on kodak_2383 (-2..+6 EV, trustability 0.3, upstream's setting for its Vision3 rows) run through the SpektraLab engine.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET inside the plotted range (density 0.4 over D-min); ASSUMED tails (exponential approach); level FITTED (sRGB 18 % grey -> 0)
tags.density_curves: SHEET (Status M, unmixed), FITTED (3 CDFs per layer, grey-ramp scale/shift on kodak_2383); ASSUMED beyond the plotted exposures
tags.channel_density: FITTED to the sheet's midscale neutral minus D-min (dmid_dmin, generic starting dyes)
tags.base_density: SHEET (D-min curve; none outside the plotted range)
tags.midscale_neutral_density: SHEET (midscale neutral curve; none outside the plotted range)
tags.hanatos2025_adaptation: FITTED (reflectance sets; window widths held at the Portra NC/VC product profiles')
tags.info: SHEET: ECN-2, tungsten balance; ASSUMED antihalation strong (rem-jet), T reference, target print kodak_2383
